title: multi-seed-calibration-runbook-and-schema-fuzz-regimen-for-fp8-int8-function-calls
creator: Asha Patel
description: Runbook and automated regimen to validate structured output (JSON/function-call) fidelity across FP8 and INT8 quantization profiles. Focus is on multi-seed calibration stability, seed-level variance analysis, per-layer clip/scale aggregation strategies, and a schema-fuzz harness that exercises edge tokenization and spacing to uncover schema drift introduced by low-precision kernels.
acceptance_criteria: SchemaPassRate >= 99.2% for canonical prompt set across >= 5 seeds for target fp8 profile
Regression delta for 'required' fields <= 0.3% vs float32 baseline
CI gate artifacts generated automatically with per-job summary and regression tags
Automated rollback policy defined: if SchemaPassRate drops > 1.5% relative to baseline, block runtime-2.3.0 rollouts for affected models
implementation_plan: Define canonical function-call prompt corpus (200 prompts) covering nested objects, optional fields, arrays, and enum edge-cases
Implement multi-seed calibration runner that executes N=5 calibration runs per quant profile and aggregates clip/scale statistics using median-of-means
Augment calibration outputs with per-layer histograms for scale factors and sparsity masks
Develop schema-fuzz harness that mutates tokenization boundaries, inserts unicode whitespace, and varies padding/truncation to simulate real prompts
Integrate the harness into CI with a nightly job and a pre-release fast job that runs a 20-prompt smoke set
Produce a comparison artifact that includes SchemaPassRate, field-level precision/recall, and a lightweight delta-score for numerical fields
testing_plan: Baseline float32 run on canonical corpus to establish golden schemas and numeric tolerances
Run fp8 and int8 quant profiles with seeds: 42, 101, 2025, 7, 999 and collect per-seed outputs
Perform round-trip parser check: generated JSON -> schema validator -> pretty-printed -> re-tokenize -> model verify to detect tokenization-sensitive regressions
Measure nondeterministic variance across seeds and flag any field with standard deviation > threshold
Run adversarial fuzz pass that targets field delimiters, quoted strings, and array separators
Add end-to-end function-call unit tests that simulate downstream consumer parsing and function invocation behavior
progress_updates: 2025-07-12: Kickoff meeting with Applied ML and Runtime teams; agreed on canonical corpus scope and initial seed set
2025-07-19: Prototype multi-seed runner implemented (CLI + Docker image). First fp8 run completed against 50 prompts; observed schema failures concentrated in nested arrays
2025-07-24: Design decision to use median-of-means for per-layer scale aggregation to reduce sensitivity to outlier calibration batches
2025-07-30: Initial schema-fuzz harness merged to feature/quant-fuzz branch. Early finds: tokenizer splits inside enum tokens caused missing required fields in ~0.9% of cases
2025-08-02: CI job definition added to .github/workflows/quant-schema.yml for nightly runs. Draft rollback policy written and reviewed by SRE
notes: Prefer tolerant JSON schema validator that can emit field-level diffs for numeric tolerance instead of binary pass/fail
Consider flagging tokens where KV-cache mismatch is suspected; correlate with per-token logits when available
If fuzz harness finds >1% required-field loss on release candidates, escalate to runtime team for temporary float fallback
